chunks: It is narrated from Jabir ibn Abdullah al-Ansari, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade a man from entering upon his family at night when returning from a journey, until he informs them beforehand.

key_terms.الْغَيْبَةِ: absence, here meaning return from a journey or being away
key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah, the Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.نَهَى: forbade; indicates a prohibition or disapproval
key_terms.يَطْرُقَ: to come upon or enter suddenly, especially by night
key_terms.يُؤْذِنَهُمْ: to inform or notify them beforehand

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about returning home at night from a journey without informing one's family?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches proper etiquette for a man returning home from absence, especially at night. The Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade arriving suddenly upon one's family without prior notice, indicating consideration, courtesy, and respect for family privacy.
